没有匹配当前筛选条件的论文。: No papers match the current filters.
选择一篇推荐论文后，这里会展示完整摘要、本地模型总结和下载操作。: Select a paper to view its full abstract, local model summary and download options.
收藏（在移动端/桌面同步，提醒下载）: Bookmark (sync across devices and remind to download)
总结失败，可稍后重新选择该论文。: Summary failed. Select this paper again later.
论文状态已回退为待处理，后端完成后会在资料库/回顾页更新。: Paper reset to pending. Library and Review will update after processing.
按结构化字段阅读论文摘要、方法与结论。: Read structured summaries, methods and findings.
检查后端是否在运行：: Check whether the backend is running:
选择左侧论文查看详情: Select a paper on the left to view details
此论文在添加 extraction_model 列之前处理，模型信息未保存。下次: This paper predates model tracking. Reprocess it to record the extraction model.
该论文尚未处理。回到资料库点击「立即处理」。: This paper is not processed yet. Select “Process now” in Library.
在右侧浮窗内浏览 PDF，可缩放、点击外部关闭并保留位置: Read the PDF in a floating panel. Zoom or click outside to close and keep your place.
点击在右侧浮窗展开 PDF（支持缩放，关闭后保留阅读位置）: Open PDF in the side panel (zoom supported, reading position preserved)
清空本地对话记录并开启新会话？: Clear local history and start a new conversation?
论文尚未完成处理，处理完成后即可追问。: Wait until paper processing finishes to ask follow-up questions.
问我任何关于这篇论文的问题。: Ask me anything about this paper.
例如：第 3 节的推导为什么成立？: For example: why does the derivation in Section 3 hold?
清空本地记录并开启新会话: Clear local history and start a new conversation
还没有对话。下面输入问题开始追问这篇论文。: No conversation yet. Enter a question below.
Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
把这条问答一键存成个人笔记: Save this question and answer as a personal note
修正 JSON 格式或字段小错误后保存，系统会重新解析这份 response，并: Fix JSON formatting or fields and save. The response will be parsed again and this paper's graph nodes rebuilt.
LaTeX 公式，例如 z = E(x), \\hat{x} = D(z): LaTeX formula, e.g. z = E(x), \hat{x} = D(z)
（输入 LaTeX 后这里实时渲染；渲染失败会原样显示，方便排错）: (LaTeX renders as you type; errors show the original text for debugging)
还没有笔记。可以按主题分块，每块只聚焦一个想法。: No notes yet. Create topic blocks, with one idea in each.
用 Markdown 写下这块笔记的内容；可直接粘贴或拖入截图…: Write in Markdown; paste or drag screenshots here…
在新标签页打开原图: Open original image in a new tab
Shift + 滚轮缩放 · + / - 键缩放 · 0 重置 · Esc 关闭: Shift + scroll or + / - to zoom · 0 to reset · Esc to close
论文抽取 / 追问、Wiki 编译、Ask 问答与生成、概念精选与健康检查共用此: Shared by paper extraction and Q&A, wiki compilation, Ask, concept curation and health checks. Vision is required for paper images. Graph embeddings and recommendations are configured separately.
将按当前阈值重算图谱边。: Recalculating graph edges with the current threshold.
确认重置自动图谱？论文会被标记为未处理，需要重新调用大模型；手动概念会保留。: Reset the automatic graph? Papers will be marked unprocessed and require model calls again. Manual concepts are retained.
自动抽取节点和边会被清空，手动概念保留。: Automatic nodes and edges will be removed; manual concepts are retained.
回到图谱页点击“处理论文”可重新生成抽取结果。: Select “Process papers” on the graph page to regenerate extraction results.
以任务为核心配置模型，Provider 区只保留必要连接参数和联通测试。: Configure models by task, with provider connections and health checks below.
扫描目录与旧版兼容设置。模型相关配置已经迁移到任务模型。: Scan directory and legacy settings. Model configuration is under Task models.
程序会递归扫描此目录下的所有 PDF 论文: Recursively scan all PDF papers in this directory
登录云端账号后，桌面端的论文 / 概念 / wiki 会增量同步到云后端，供 i: Sign in to incrementally sync desktop papers, concepts and wiki to the cloud for read-only mobile access.
除“图谱向量”外的所有任务共用一个主模型；向量单独配置。Provider 区只保: Tasks share a main model; graph embeddings are configured separately. Provider settings contain connection parameters and tests.
这里只保留必要连接参数。内部的 provider 元数据和模型注册表不再暴露给你: Only connection parameters are shown. Qwen defaults to the Beijing OpenAI-compatible endpoint; you can change the region.
主模型、图谱向量和论文精选分别配置。论文精选默认使用 Codex CLI；更换主: Configure the main model, graph embeddings and recommendations separately. Recommendations default to Codex CLI and do not change when the main model changes.
为论文抽取附带首页图像: Include the first-page image in extraction
首页通常包含标题、作者和摘要，有助于抽取模型更准确地识别元信息。只有绑定到支持视: The first page often contains title, authors and abstract. It helps identify metadata and requires a vision-capable model.
当前“论文抽取”绑定的模型未声明支持视觉，首页图像会被忽略。: The paper extraction model does not declare vision support; the image will be ignored.
`thinking_effort` 当前会作用于 `Responses API`: `thinking_effort` applies to Responses API and Codex CLI. Embeddings and chat.completions models ignore it.
低阈值产生更多连接，高阈值更精确: Lower values create more connections; higher values are more precise.
用当前阈值重新计算节点间的相似边，不调用大模型，免费快速。: Recalculate similarity edges with the current threshold. No model calls; fast and free.
清空自动抽取的知识节点和边，将论文标记为未处理。手动新增的概念会保留；重新处理论: Clear automatically extracted nodes and edges and mark papers unprocessed. Manual concepts stay; reprocessing calls the model again.
让 Knowra 更适合你的阅读习惯。更改后即时生效并自动保存。: Make Knowra feel like your own. Changes apply immediately and save automatically.
界面与新任务的提示词按语言加载。每种语言的修改独立保存，已有内容保持原样。: The interface and prompts for new tasks follow your language. Edits are saved per language; existing content stays as it is.
语言保存失败，请检查后端连接后重试。: Could not save language. Check the backend connection and retry.
仅调整界面配色，主题偏好保存在当前设备。: Changes interface colors only. Your theme is saved on this device.
Prompt 加载失败，请重新打开面板重试。: Could not load prompt. Reopen the panel to retry.
健康检查任务已变更，请查看最新报告。: Health check changed; view the latest report.
健康检查未完整完成，请查看报告。: Health check incomplete; view the report.
未配置 Supabase URL / anon key，请到设置 → 云同步填写: Set Supabase URL / anon key under Settings → Cloud sync.
未配置云后端 URL，请到设置 → 云同步填写: Set the cloud backend URL under Settings → Cloud sync.
当前云端服务尚未启用个性化推荐。服务升级完成后即可使用，已有论文和全部论文推荐不: Personalized recommendations are not enabled on this cloud service yet. Existing papers and general recommendations are unaffected.
本机推荐服务尚未加载，请重启新版桌面后端。此功能不需要云端登录。: Local recommendation service not loaded. Restart the updated desktop backend; no cloud sign-in is needed.
正在解析论文，编译会在结束后自动接力。: Papers are being parsed; compilation follows automatically.
概念筛选正在后台运行，可以切换页面，任务不会中断。: Curation runs in the background. You can navigate without interrupting it.
有 {0} 篇新论文待解析，先把它们入库再做后续步骤。: {0} new papers await parsing. Import them before continuing.
这些论文此前处理失败，需要重试，而不是提交新的待处理任务。: These papers failed previously. Retry them instead of submitting new tasks.
有 {0} 个待评候选节点，建议先跑「自动剔除」筛掉无效条目。: {0} candidates await review. Run auto-curation to filter invalid entries.
Agent 已给出 {0} 个剔除判断，确认后下次自动剔除不会再覆盖。: The agent made {0} decisions. Confirming protects them from future automatic overrides.
有 {0} 个论文页待编译或已过期。: {0} paper pages are pending or outdated.
有 {0} 个概念页待编译或已过期。: {0} concept pages are pending or outdated.
已编译内容有过更新，健康检查报告需要刷新。: Compiled content has changed; refresh the health report.
已编译概念 ≥ 1，建议跑一次健康检查找出短桩 / 可合并项。: At least one concept is compiled. Run a health check for stubs and merge candidates.
从零开始：先扫描论文目录。: Start by scanning your paper directory.
所有阶段都已完成，可以打开 Ask 提问或继续添加论文。: All stages are complete. Open Ask or add more papers.
云端拒收，未写入任何数据：{0}{1}: Cloud rejected the data; nothing written: {0}{1}
基于标题和摘要，对个人候选列表评分并解释推荐理由: Rank candidates from titles and abstracts and explain recommendations.
数据已清理，数据库正在使用，空闲空间将供后续写入复用；可稍后再次整理。: Data cleared. The database is busy; free space will be reused for future writes. You can compact again later.
